description: Look at a .glb or .gltf without Godot or a picture: three views (front, side, top) drawn with letters, one letter per part, then a list of the parts with their sizes and heights, and which parts do not touch the rest of the model (a ladder away from its tree, a wheel without an axle, something floating). `only` shows one of the views; `width` sets the characters per view (default 48). Use it after building to check the shape, proportions and that everything is attached. Read-only. For a rendered picture use godot_screenshot (needs Godot); for triangles, materials and textures use godot_model_inspect; for problems use godot_model_lint.

file.description: Path to a .glb or .gltf file, inside the project.

width.description: width of the views in characters (default 48)

name: godot_model_view
title: See a 3D model as text
